'''Drossh''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He and his partner, [[Rezzo]], were smuggling weapons when they had a disagreement, and accidentally set off an explosive, [[Death/Legends|killing]] both of them in the blast. Their damaged ship, the ''[[Vor'Teth]]'', was later found and sold as scrap.
